title: 여신전문금융업법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Types of Deposits, etc.)
1.  The types of deposits as defined in Article 25(5) of the Act shall be as follows, but the valuation of deposits as specified in items 2 or 3 shall be in accordance with Article 63(1) of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Act.
    1. Cash
    2. Domestic bonds, government bonds, and corporate bonds listed on the Korea Exchange (hereinafter referred to as "Korea Exchange") as defined in the Act on Capital Markets and Investment Securities
    3. Stocks or equity interests listed on the Korea Exchange for more than 3 months
2.  Credit card companies shall deposit the amount as defined in Article 8 of the Act by the last day of the month following the end of each quarter.
